metadata:
  id: ACME.IAC.RESOURCE.LOCAL.FILE.ID_SET
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The manifest file has the id of what the apply wrote
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: local
        resource_types: [local_file]
  when:
    path: resource.name
    equal: manifest
  assert:
    path: resource.after.id
    equal: "631d2e4018226c254b97ce95f661d3a53b578cd5"
